statement: The Vera Rubin NVL72 rack is claimed to deliver up to 10x better inference per watt than Blackwell and to need up to one-fourth fewer GPUs for the same work.
why: Large gains in work done per watt and per chip stretch existing power and chip budgets, effectively adding usable compute without adding equivalent silicon or megawatts.

impact.mechanism: Better performance per watt raises effective compute supply per installed rack and per megawatt, easing the power ceiling while reducing chip count needed for a given workload.

evidence.excerpt: up to 10x better inference per watt

confidence.basis: Vendor performance claim with 'up to' framing, reported in a single company newsroom post and not independently benchmarked here.
